description: Erection of rear and side dormer roof extensions and the installation of two front roof windows to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GD2430/01, GD2430/03, Fire Statement Received 05 September 2022
GD2430/02 Rev B, GD2430/04 Received 02 November 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side dormer shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
